brief:
Roughly 1,300 Palestinian children participated in a swimming class on Gaza's shore, according to Al Jazeera English. The event was organized to help young people process psychological wounds inflicted by the conflict. Organizers brought the children to the beach in what appeared to be a coordinated effort to provide relief and normalcy amid ongoing hardship.

The gathering underscores efforts by Palestinians to support children's mental health during a period marked by military operations and humanitarian strain. Gaza's population, particularly its youth, has faced repeated cycles of displacement and violence over years of conflict. The swimming activity represented one attempt by local organizers to create a space where children could experience a measure of safety and community connection away from the immediate effects of the crisis.
dek: On Gaza’s shore, 1,300 Palestinian children joined a swimming class to cope with the trauma of Israel’s genocidal war.
title: Gaza organizes mass swimming class for traumatized children
